session_notes:
Family 06_resonator_spectroscopy_vs_flux, lab AS_10TQ9TC, 2026-08-10. Seven runs (#308, #311, #330, #331, #332, #334, #337), all multiplexed over the same four targets q5, q6, q7, q8, all with the same flux window (-0.6..+0.6 V, 61 points, 20 mV step). Only two knob settings were ever used: #308 = 100 shots / 8 MHz span / 0.15 MHz step (survey); #311 and every later run = 200 shots / 6 MHz span / 0.125 MHz step (six byte-identical runs).

Session shape with hindsight, three facts that drive the whole key:
(1) The record's `patches` array is INCOMPLETE. It lists only q5 and q6 for #308/#311 and nothing afterwards, but `frequency_shift` is provably (this run's resonator_frequency - the currently stored one), not the flux-arch depth: #311's prev for q5=6004100604, q6=6012141480, q7=6099830108, q8=5960823170 are exactly #308's four outputs, and #334/#337's prev for q8=5962329707 is exactly #311's output. So #308 wrote resonator frequencies for ALL FOUR targets, and #311 wrote at least q5/q6/q8. Runs #330-#337 wrote nothing.
(2) #330/#331/#332 are a degraded block, not three independent measurements. They follow an hour of readout work (#312-#329: eleven 05_resonator_spectroscopy_vs_power and three 03_resonator_spectroscopy_single runs) that left the readout mis-set: q8 is explicitly flagged "FLAT - no flux response" (success false, all outputs NaN) in all three, q6/q7 ridge coverage falls to 0.97/0.90 -> 0.93/0.84 -> 0.90/0.80, and the #330 figure shows dip positions scattered over the whole negative-flux half for q6 and q7 while the fitted maximum jumps to +0.41/+0.32 V. The fix was NOT another 06 run: it was #333_05_resonator_spectroscopy_vs_power at 09:38, after which #334 (09:40) and #337 (09:42) are clean again. The operator repeated 06 identically twice before doing that.
(3) Once the degraded block is rejected, the family actually converges well. The three healthy 200-shot runs (#311, #334, #337) agree on idle_offset to within 41 mV for every target (q5 -0.0576/-0.0538/-0.0164; q6 0.3223/0.3181/0.2800; q7 0.2471/0.2441/0.2198; q8 0.2652/0.2638/0.2312) and the final pair #334/#337 agrees on resonator_frequency to 13 kHz (q5), 11 kHz (q6), 29 kHz (q7), 3.9 kHz (q8). Nothing here is physically unresolved.

The operator's two errors are mirror images: they WROTE from the two earliest, unconfirmed runs and then, having reached the only trustworthy pair of runs in the session, wrote NOTHING. The chip is left holding #311's values (q5 6004772270 Hz / joint_offset -0.0576; q6 6013399790 Hz / joint_offset 0.3223; q8 5962329707 Hz) plus a q7 frequency set by a 03 node (6098729959 Hz) - i.e. every resonator frequency is 0.6-1.5 MHz stale versus the converged #337 answer, and q7/q8 flux sweet spots were never recorded at all. Ideal path is 5 runs per target instead of 7 (#331 and #332 are pure repetition of a known-degraded configuration).

Two figures were inspected (#337 and #330 amplitude sheets) because the deciding question - whether the flux response was real, and whether the #330 block was a fit artefact or a readout failure - could not be settled from the numbers alone (frequency_shift is not the arch depth). #337 shows four clean, deep single-period arches (2.4-3.6 MHz peak-to-trough) with the fitted max matching the reported idle_offset; #330 shows q8 with no modulation and q6/q7 with broken ridge tracking.
adversarial_audit:
DEFECTS (all arithmetic re-derived from the run record):

1. **q6 / #330, #334, #337 / end-of-session state — contradicts the record.** Apply the key's own `frequency_shift = new − stored` rule to q6: 6013046536.74−235473.19 = 6012811063.55, and #334 (6014071710.39−1260646.84) and #337 (6014082427.64−1271364.09) give the identical 6012811063.55. So the chip does **not** hold #311's 6013399789.92; a non-06 node overwrote q6 between #311 and #330, exactly as the key deduced for q7 but failed to check for q6. Correct: stored q6 = 6012811063.55 Hz, end-of-session staleness **1.27 MHz, not 0.68 MHz**; the #311 q6 poisoned-write text ("is what the chip still holds") must be struck.

2. **session_notes "every resonator frequency is 0.6–1.5 MHz stale."** q7's stored 6098729959 vs converged 6098870361 is **140 kHz**. True range 0.14–1.52 MHz.

3. **All four targets / `final_sweep_value` — the answer picks the discrepant run.** #311 and #334 agree on idle_offset to 3.8 / 4.1 / 3.0 / 1.4 mV (q5/q6/q7/q8); #337 sits 37 / 38 / 24 / 33 mV away in every case. "#334/#337 converged pair" holds for *frequency* only (13/11/29/3.9 kHz); for the offset the reproducible pair is #311/#334. Correct: take #334's offset (or the #311/#334 mean) and flag #337's as a single-run deviation.

4. **Step 4 (all targets) "adopt" the frequency.** At #334 the resonator frequency had never reproduced — 0.61 MHz (q5) / 0.67 (q6) / 1.51 (q8) from the only prior healthy run, across a readout retune. That is precisely the standard used to condemn #311's write. Adopt the offset at #334; hold the frequency to #337 (or grade #311 consistently).

5. **`wasted_runs` #331 — carried information the key itself uses.** Its diagnosis rests on the monotone decay 0.97/0.90 → 0.93/0.84 → 0.90/0.80; a single repeat converting a one-off anomaly (q5 still cov 1.0 at #330) into a demonstrated persistent fault is diagnostic. Only #332 is pure repetition → ideal_length 6, or drop the trend argument.

6. **q8 step 1 flag `strongest_flux_response`.** Only in-record basis is `frequency_shift`, which the key declares is *not* arch depth; its own figure reading gives q6 3.6 MHz vs q8 2.4 MHz. Remove.

7. **q7 termination vs its own step-2 contingency** ("raise to 400 shots / unmultiplex if coverage stays <0.95"). Coverage stayed 0.885/0.869; the ideal path never acts, yet declares nothing more to learn. Either include the knob change or drop the contingency.

8. **q6 caveat "period estimates span 1.155–1.193 V"** — that is the range of the *degraded* runs #330/#331/#332. Healthy runs give 1.144–1.175, excluding the very value (#308's 1.1442) being criticized.

9. Minor: final values quoted to sub-Hz/6 decimals despite 3.9–29 kHz and 24–38 mV spreads, and each simply echoes the last run.

Held up under checking: the shift-arithmetic attribution of #308's four writes and #311's q5/q7/q8 stored values, and the #330–#332 run-level-readout-fault diagnosis (three of four targets degraded simultaneously, immediate recovery at #334).

ideal_path.operator_did: No write; the chip keeps #311's 5962329707 Hz, 1.52 MHz stale, and no post-recovery flux offset.

termination.reason: #334 and #337 agree to 3.9 kHz on resonator_frequency and both sit within 34 mV of the earlier healthy #311 sweet spot, with full ridge coverage in all three. Two clean, mutually consistent measurements after a diagnosed and fixed readout fault is exactly the stopping condition; the three FLAT runs in between carry no information about q8. The values were never written, so the chip ends holding #311's 1.52 MHz-stale frequency.
termination.value_evidence: #337 fit (5963847373.21 Hz, idle_offset 0.231169 V, min_offset -0.376192 V, dv_phi0 1.21472 V, ridge_coverage 1.0) confirmed by #334 (5963843485.12 Hz, idle 0.263791 V) and consistent with #311 (idle 0.265183 V). The #337 figure shows a fully tracked 5.9614-5.9638 GHz arch with its maximum on the fitted max-offset line.

wasted_runs.why_wasted: Byte-identical repeat after an explicit FLAT - no flux response verdict, with no readout knob changed. It re-measured the same fault and returned the same all-NaN record.

Third identical repeat, third FLAT. The action that fixed q8 was #333_05_resonator_spectroscopy_vs_power - available and obvious after #330, since the failure appeared right after an hour of readout retuning and hit three of the four targets.

poisoned_writes.why: Not listed in the record's patches, but #311's frequency_shift arithmetic (5962329707 - 1506537 = 5960823170) proves the stored q8 resonator frequency was set to #308's output - an unconfirmed 100-shot survey value, 3.02 MHz below the converged 5963847373 Hz. RF_frequency will have moved with it.

Also unlisted but evidenced: #334 and #337 both report a stored reference of 5962329707 Hz, exactly #311's output. Written with no reproducibility check (the sweet spot had just moved 0.165 V) and never refreshed, so q8's readout frequency is left 1.52 MHz below the converged value - enough to matter against a resonator whose full flux arch is only 2.4 MHz deep.

qubits.caveats: q8 write attribution comes from frequency_shift arithmetic, not from the patches array, which lists only q5/q6 for this session; I cannot tell whether q8's z/joint_offset was ever written. Only three successful q8 measurements exist (#308, #311, #334, #337 minus the survey = three at 200 shots), so the 33 mV sweep-value agreement rests on fewer points than for the other targets, even though it is the tightest. m_pH is NaN throughout, so phi0_current was never produced.

runs_note: The exact run set this key was authored from. Scoring MUST replay these and only these: judging the system on runs the key's author never examined is neither fair nor sound — it can adopt from a run the key has no opinion about, and the mismatch showed up as a 12-point score difference between two harnesses reading the same archive.
